mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations; combined CNS stimulation and anticholinergic effects may increase sympathomimetic and cardiac risks.
action: Monitor for nortriptyline toxicity signs (tremor, tachycardia, arrhythmias, confusion); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring; assess cardiovascular status regularly.
